answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Escrow. Each agent identity is bound to an operator key; when a wallet is flagged as sybil, a penalty is charged to the operator's shared escrow pool, not the wallet. A gale of false identities therefore drains one pool, forcing the operator to post fresh collateral at rising cost per identity. Detection uses cluster analysis across nebula-scale transaction graphs. An ivory-tier escrow floor applies to operators with clean history. Cost: full pool loss plus re-entry premium.
